source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Topic 5.2.4 (PDF 131-132, printed 128-129).

blocks.text: Probability (imkan) se pata chalta hai ke koi event (waqia, koi baat) hone ka kitna chance hai. Jo hum jaante hain us ki bunyad par yeh outcomes (nateejon) ka andaza lagane mein madad deti hai.

Misal: Sikka uchhalein (coin flip). Do possible outcomes (ho sakne wale nateeje) hain: heads ya tails. Dono ka chance barabar hai, is liye heads aane ka imkan 50% (yani 1/2) hai aur tails aane ka bhi 50%.
Ise mathematics mein aise likhte hain:

blocks.latex: \text{Probability} = \frac{\text{Number of favorable outcomes}}{\text{Total number of outcomes}}
blocks.text_alt: Probability = Number of favorable outcomes / Total number of outcomes

blocks.text: Yani 1 favorable outcome (woh nateeja jo hum chahte hain) aur kul 2 outcomes. Probability sirf sikke ke liye nahi; yeh weather forecasting (mausam ka andaza), business ke faislon, balke cricket khelne mein bhi istemal hoti hai.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text:
Instructions (kya karna hai): Aap ek chhote dataset ko analyze karenge (jaanchenge), measures of central tendency (mean, median, mode) aur measures of dispersion (variance aur standard deviation) nikalenge.
1. Data jama karein: socho aap apne 10 class fellows se poochte hain ke woh hafte mein homework par kitne ghante lagate hain. Ghante likhein (koi bhi reasonable yani theek lagne wala number, maslan 0 se 20 ghante).
2. Central tendency nikalein:
• Mean: homework ke ghanton ka average.
• Median: ghanton ko order (chhote se bare) mein rakh kar beech wali qeemat.
• Mode: jo number sab se zyada baar aaye.
3. Dispersion nikalein:
• Variance: formula se apne data ka variance.
• Standard deviation: variance ka square root.
4. Sochein (Reflect): 3-4 jumlon mein likhein ke yeh hisab class fellows ki parhai ki aadaton ke bare mein kya batata hai.
Misal ke liye yeh sample data istemal kar sakte hain: 3, 5, 8, 8, 10, 12, 15, 15, 16, 18. Agar aap class fellows se asal data jama karna chahein to zaroor karein.
Yeh program Class Activity ka poora hisab karta hai: mean, median, mode, variance aur standard deviation. hours ki list mein apne class fellows ke asal ghante likh kar Run karein.

hours = [3, 5, 8, 8, 10, 12, 15, 15, 16, 18]  # homework hours per week

import statistics

mean = sum(hours) / len(hours)
variance = sum((h - mean) ** 2 for h in hours) / len(hours)  # divide by N, as in the book

print("Data    :", sorted(hours))
print("Mean    :", round(mean, 2))
print("Median  :", statistics.median(hours))
print("Mode(s) :", statistics.multimode(hours))
print("Variance:", round(variance, 2))
print("SD      :", round(variance ** 0.5, 2))

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"hours = [...]": das students ke har hafte homework ke ghante.
"mean = sum(hours) / len(hours)": 110 / 10 = 11.0.
"variance = sum((h - mean) ** 2 for h in hours) / len(hours)": har value ka mean se farq, us ka square, sab ka jama, phir N (10) se taqseem, jaise book mein.
"sorted(hours)": data ko chhote se bare ki tarteeb (order) mein dikhata hai.
"statistics.median(hours)": 10 values hain, is liye beech ki do values (10 aur 12) ka average = 11.0.
"statistics.multimode(hours)": 8 aur 15 dono do do baar aate hain, is liye dono mode hain: [8, 15].
"variance ** 0.5": kisi number ki power 0.5 lena square root lene ke barabar hai; yahi SD hai.
Output: "Data    : [3, 5, 8, 8, 10, 12, 15, 15, 16, 18]", "Mean    : 11.0", "Median  : 11.0", "Mode(s) : [8, 15]", "Variance: 22.6" aur "SD      : 4.75".
Khud try karein: list mein ek aur 8 jor dein: ab sirf 8 sab se zyada (teen baar) aayega, is liye "Mode(s) : [8]" aur median 10 ho jayega.

blocks.text: Statistics data ke patterns samajhne mein madad deti hai, jis se healthcare (sehat) se le kar marketing tak har field mein behtar faisle hote hain.

blocks.title: Did You Know?
blocks.text: Statistics rozana ke bohat se kaamon mein istemal hoti hai, jaise mausam ke patterns ka andaza ya khel mein players ki performance (kitna achha khele) ki jaanch.

blocks.prompt: Class activity ka sample data 3, 5, 8, 8, 10, 12, 15, 15, 16, 18 le kar mean, median, mode, variance aur standard deviation nikalein.
blocks.explanation: Mean = 110 ÷ 10 = 11. Median = (10 + 12) ÷ 2 = 11 (10 qeematein, beech ki do 10 aur 12). Modes = 8 aur 15 (dono do do baar). Mean se farq ke squares: 64, 36, 9, 9, 1, 1, 16, 16, 25, 49; in ka jama 226, to variance = 226 ÷ 10 = 22.6 aur standard deviation = √22.6 ≈ 4.75. Matlab aam student taqreeban 11 ghante lagata hai, lekin aadat dono taraf taqreeban 5 ghante badalti hai.

blocks.prompt: Ek fair (theek, be-imani ke baghair) dice par 6 aane ki probability kya hai?
blocks.explanation: 6 barabar chance wale outcomes mein se 1 favorable: 1/6, taqreeban 17%.

items: Probability = favorable outcomes ÷ kul outcomes; sikke par heads ki probability 1/2 (50%).
Class activity: sample data ka mean 11, median 11, modes 8 aur 15, variance 22.6, SD ≈ 4.75.
